commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a bundled Google Antigravity `agy` CLI provider/backend, changes Gemini CLI OAuth to import the official CLI cache, and adds provider-owned CLI auth credential forwarding through the Plugin SDK.

PR surface: Source +1105, Tests +957, Docs +78, Generated 0, Other +361. Total +2501 across 44 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review finding by source inspection: the new backend uses text output, the generic parser accepts empty text, and upstream reports empty stdout/stderr failures for `agy --print`.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow repair can address the empty-output Antigravity failure; the larger auth/SDK compatibility questions still need maintainer review.

target.title: feat(google): add Antigravity agy auth bridge
target.body:
## Summary

This PR adds first-class `google-antigravity` support through the Antigravity `agy --print` runtime and hardens the surrounding Google auth replacement boundary.

Provider split:

- `google-antigravity` uses the signed-in Antigravity / `agy` session.
- `google-gemini-cli` uses the official Gemini CLI OAuth cache.
- `google` remains the Gemini API-key provider.

For Antigravity, OpenClaw does not import or persist raw Google OAuth tokens. OAuth/session ownership stays with Antigravity, and OpenClaw delegates execution to `agy`.

## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw already separates Google API-key auth, Gemini CLI OAuth, and provider-owned runtime auth paths, but it did not have a first-class Antigravity provider path. Users with a signed-in Antigravity / `agy` session could not route OpenClaw model execution through Antigravity without collapsing that path into Gemini CLI OAuth or Google API-key handling.

This PR also had a cleanup bug in the CLI preparation path: if Claude skills plugin setup failed after backend preparation, prepared backend or execution resources were not cleaned up before the error propagated.

This PR adds `google-antigravity` as a provider-owned CLI runtime path. OpenClaw delegates Antigravity execution to `agy --print`, keeps Antigravity session ownership outside OpenClaw, preserves separation from `google-gemini-cli` OAuth and `google` API-key auth, forwards selected Antigravity model refs to `agy --model`, and cleans prepared resources when skills plugin setup fails.

## What Changed

### Antigravity

- Added bundled `google-antigravity` provider registration.
- Added a `google-antigravity` CLI backend.
- Routed Antigravity prompts through `agy --print` with a bounded print timeout.
- Forwarded selected Antigravity model refs to `agy --model`.
- Added setup support for a local `google-antigravity:antigravity-session` profile.
- Added runtime auth resolution for the Antigravity app-session profile.
- Added external/synthetic auth handling so OpenClaw can detect the Antigravity session without importing raw Google OAuth tokens.
- Added provider aliases, model policy wiring, docs, and live-testing notes.

### Gemini CLI

- Added official Gemini CLI OAuth cache import support for `google-gemini-cli`.
- Changed Gemini CLI setup to import the official cache instead of launching an OpenClaw-owned Google browser auth flow.
- Required validated active Google account identity before saving or using imported Gemini CLI credentials.
- Added legacy profile recovery when an older `google-gemini-cli` profile lacks account identity and the official cache matches the expected profile.
- Failed closed on missing or mismatched Gemini CLI account identity.
- Preserved isolated Gemini CLI auth-home staging and inherited Google auth env clearing.

### Shared auth/backend boundary

- Added provider-owned CLI backend auth resolution.
- Preserved generic fallback forwarding only when no provider-owned hook exists.
- Made provider hook decline fail closed instead of falling through to generic forwarding.
- Preserved backend allowlist checks before and after auth resolution.
- Preserved Gemini API-key staging for `google` API-key profiles.
- Fixed CLI runner cleanup gaps on mid-prepare failures.
- Updated Plugin SDK exports, API baseline, and CLI backend docs.

### Cleanup and rebase follow-up

- Clean prepared backend/execution resources when `prepareClaudeCliSkillsPlugin` throws after backend preparation.
- Added a focused regression test for the skills-plugin setup failure path.
- Rebased the branch onto current `origin/main`.
- Refreshed Plugin SDK surface budget counts after the rebase changed generated surface totals.

## Evidence

**Real environment tested:** PR #99733 current head `71e10f3887cfc92fce5ff6d26ff72e50f85d3622` on the local OpenClaw checkout.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch:** Direct Antigravity CLI control, sterile-home Antigravity CLI control, OpenClaw live runtime through `pnpm openclaw qa manual`, non-default Antigravity model proof through direct `agy --model gemini-3-pro-high` and OpenClaw-routed `google-antigravity/gemini-3-pro-high`, auth-boundary proof through `pnpm exec tsx scripts/proof-google-auth-replacement.ts`, and current-head cleanup regression validation through `pnpm test src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts`, `pnpm check:test-types`, and `git diff --check`.

**Evidence after fix:**

Antigravity non-default model proof:

    local head: 00d9c2b1b2fae14931cc29381a20d44ae828a449
    PR head:    00d9c2b1b2fae14931cc29381a20d44ae828a449

Direct `agy --model` command:

    agy --model gemini-3-pro-high --print "Reply exactly: PR99733_AGY_MODEL_HIGH_OK" --print-timeout 2m0s

Direct `agy --model` output:

    PR99733_AGY_MODEL_HIGH_OK

OpenClaw-routed non-default Antigravity model command:

    ANTIGRAVITY_USER_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.config/Antigravity" \
      pnpm openclaw qa manual \
        --provider-mode live-frontier \
        --model google-antigravity/gemini-3-pro-high \
        --message "Reply exactly: PR99733_AGY_MODEL_HIGH_OK" \
        --timeout-ms 240000

OpenClaw-routed non-default Antigravity model output:

    {
      "model": "google-antigravity/gemini-3-pro-high",
      "waited": {
        "runId": "1926be15-0d21-4274-8f20-b519867ad421",
        "status": "ok",
        "startedAt": 1783164395368,
        "endedAt": 1783164399241
      },
      "reply": "PR99733_AGY_MODEL_HIGH_OK",
      "watchUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:45387"
    }

Current-head cleanup proof:

    status:

    diff files:

    current head:
    00d9c2b1b2fae14931cc29381a20d44ae828a449

Focused cleanup regression test at current head:

    $ node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts
    [test] starting test/vitest/vitest.agents.config.ts

     RUN  v4.1.8 /home/rev/projects/openclaw-pr-99733-20260703-213936

     ✓  agents  src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts (65 tests) 4100ms
         ✓ passes raw refreshed OAuth profile fields to profile-owned CLI preparation  1453ms

     Test Files  1 passed (1)
          Tests  65 passed (65)
       Start at  22:47:06
       Duration  12.70s (transform 6.28s, setup 163ms, import 8.30s, tests 4.10s, environment 0ms)

    [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 18.49s

Current-head type and diff checks:

    proof status:
    $ pnpm tsgo:test
    $ pnpm tsgo:core:test && pnpm tsgo:extensions:test
    $ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo
    $ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo

Prior Antigravity live behavior proof captured before the cleanup-only follow-up commit:

Terminal head check:

    PR head:    94a894f4a09d95750823a30464afe2a6a13c0910
    local head: 94a894f4a09d95750823a30464afe2a6a13c0910

Direct Antigravity CLI command:

    agy --print "Reply exactly: PR99733_CA21_AGY_DIRECT_OK" --print-timeout 2m0s

Direct Antigravity CLI output:

    PR99733_CA21_AGY_DIRECT_OK

Sterile-home Antigravity CLI command:

    HOME="$PROOF_HOME" \
    ANTIGRAVITY_USER_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.config/Antigravity" \
    agy --print "Reply exactly: PR99733_CA21_AGY_STERILE_OK" --print-timeout 2m0s

Sterile-home Antigravity CLI output:

    PR99733_CA21_AGY_STERILE_OK

OpenClaw Antigravity live runtime command:

    ANTIGRAVITY_USER_DATA_DIR="$HOME/.config/Antigravity" \
    TMPDIR="$PROOF_TMP" \
    pnpm openclaw qa manual \
      --provider-mode live-frontier \
      --model google-antigravity/gemini-3-flash \
      --message "Reply exactly: PR99733_CA21_OPENCLAW_AGY_OK" \
      --timeout-ms 240000

OpenClaw Antigravity live runtime output:

    {
      "model": "google-antigravity/gemini-3-flash",
      "waited": {
        "runId": "db4a2d3e-45cb-4d41-b755-6d4d9d5ad976",
        "status": "ok",
        "startedAt": 1783131262143,
        "endedAt": 1783131265714
      },
      "reply": "PR99733_CA21_OPENCLAW_AGY_OK",
      "watchUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:46707"
    }

Auth-boundary proof command:

    pnpm exec tsx scripts/proof-google-auth-replacement.ts

Auth-boundary proof output verified:

- Registered Gemini CLI provider hook.
- Generic fallback remains available for the Google API-key provider.
- CLI runner forwards OAuth through the registered provider hook.
- CLI runner forwards API keys through generic fallback.
- Google API-key and Gemini CLI OAuth profile selection remain separated.
- Official Gemini CLI OAuth cache, account, and project import paths are covered.
- Gemini CLI setup imports the official cache instead of using OpenClaw OAuth.
- Gemini CLI uses isolated auth-home staging.
- Inherited Google auth environment is cleared.
- API-key profiles do not write Gemini CLI OAuth files.
- API-key profile staging remains Gemini API-key only.
- OAuth token values are redacted from proof output.
- Profile homes use resolver-derived paths.
- Raw profile ids are absent from the staged home.

Selected credential kinds from proof output:

    {
      "google-gemini-cli": "oauth",
      "google": "api_key"
    }

**Observed result after fix:** OpenClaw routed `google-antigravity/gemini-3-flash` through the `agy --print` runtime and received the exact expected live response from the backend. OpenClaw also routed `google-antigravity/gemini-3-pro-high` through the Antigravity backend and received the exact expected response while direct `agy --model gemini-3-pro-high` returned the same expected proof string. The current-head cleanup regression also passed, proving prepared execution cleanup runs when skills plugin setup fails.

**What was not tested:**

- I did not run the full repository test suite.
- I did not prove successful Gemini CLI model generation with the live account.
- I did not prove Google API-key generation because this machine does not have a Google API key available.
- The targeted gateway live harness is not claimed here. The product/runtime proof is captured with `pnpm openclaw qa manual`, which reaches the actual `google-antigravity` backend and returns the expected response.

## Validation

Focused validation was run locally:

    pnpm test extensions/google/index-harness-registration.test.ts extensions/google/setup-api.test.ts extensions/google/index.test.ts src/agents/cli-backends.test.ts src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts src/agents/model-provider-auth.worker.test.ts src/agents/model-catalog.test.ts
    pnpm test src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts
    pnpm check:test-types
    pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check
    git diff --check

Result: passed for the focused Vitest and type/surface/diff checks that were run.

The Plugin SDK API baseline and surface budgets were refreshed after generated baseline and rebase-related budget drift.

## Tests
